shots.vo: Why choose K J Somaiya College of Engineering?

shots.visual: Exterior shot of a modern college building surrounded by lush green trees.
shots.vo: Established in 1983, it is a leading engineering institute in Mumbai.

shots.visual: Panoramic view of the sprawling campus grounds and sports area.
shots.vo: Your journey happens on a vibrant campus featuring twenty libraries and a twenty acre sports and recreational area. You can even join over twenty clubs.

shots.visual: Modern interior laboratory space with advanced equipment and instruments.
shots.vo: Experience incredible milestones, like the successful launch of the satellite Somaiya BeliefSat zero by ISRO.

shots.visual: Architectural shot of campus buildings under a bright sunny sky.
shots.vo: Our community is built on innovation and trust.

shots.vo: Explore Somaiya - details on the official website at www.somaiya.edu or email admissions at admissions@somaiya.edu.
